entries.text: Adytum, that town doesn't have a chance in hell.

entries.text: 内城区，那个地方真是万劫不复了。

entries.source_text: What about the Followers?

entries.text: Can I help Adytum?
entries.source_text: Can I help Adytum?

entries.text: 我能帮助内城区吗？
entries.source_text: 我能帮助内城区吗？

The Children don't think we're enough of a threat.

entries.text: 教徒们以为我们不会有足够的力量威胁到他们。我们会让他们知道的。

entries.text: Good. What do you plan to do?
entries.source_text: Good. What do you plan to do?

entries.text: 好。你计划做什么？
entries.source_text: 好。你计划做什么？

entries.text: Can I help Adytum in any way?
entries.source_text: Can I help Adytum in any way?

entries.text: 我能帮内城区任何忙吗？
entries.source_text: 我能帮内城区任何忙吗？

entries.text: Yeah, you can help 'em by getting to the Master. 'Bite the# head off the snake and it won't coil around you,' as my grandmother used# to say. She was kind of a handful.

entries.text: 可以，拯救内城区最好的办法就是找到主教。我祖母常说：“打蛇打七寸”，她很有见地哦。

entries.source_text: Adytum's already fallen. The Hub is next.

entries.source_text: 内城区已经沦陷了。哈勃城是下一个。

entries.source_text: What're the Followers doing during this?

entries.text: 这期间末世论者在做什么？
entries.source_text: 这期间末世论者在做什么？

entries.text: Damn. What can I do?
entries.source_text: Damn. What can I do?

entries.text: 可恶。我能做什么？
entries.source_text: 可恶。我能做什么？

entries.text: We sent a group to help Adytum,# and they were all wiped out. Nicole sent another# one to the Hub. I just hope they get there in time.

entries.source_text: Damn. What can I do?

They've already taken out the Hub and Adytum!

entries.source_text: 他们已经拿下了哈勃城和内城区！我想末世论就是下一个，所以我们在准备防御。

entries.source_text: Why are you here then?

entries.text: 你为什么还在这？
entries.source_text: 你为什么还在这？

entries.text: What can I do?
entries.source_text: What can I do?

entries.text: 我能做什么？
entries.source_text: 我能做什么？

entries.text: I'm here to keep an eye on the Children.
entries.source_text: I'm here to keep an eye on the Children.

entries.text: 我在这里监视着教徒们。
entries.source_text: 我在这里监视着教徒们。

The Children are setting up hospitals all over the place.

entries.source_text: 教徒们在所有的地方建起了医院。哼。我想他们想获得人们的信任。

entries.text: Is it working?
entries.source_text: Is it working?

entries.text: 这招管用吗？
entries.source_text: 这招管用吗？

entries.text: Is there anyway to stop them?
entries.source_text: Is there anyway to stop them?

entries.source_text: 有什么办法阻止他们？

entries.source_text: That's the stupidest thing I ever heard!

entries.text: 啊，看上去确实管用。我的意思是，人们对大教堂趋之若鹜。真可怜，他们难道看不出这是骗局吗？

# . . . well, they're a little paranoid, so don't

entries.text: 内城区，在这的西边。而且那里的人……哎，他们有点偏执狂，所以不要指望有热情的欢迎。
entries.source_text: 内城区，在这的西边。而且那里的人……哎，他们有点偏执狂，所以不要指望有热情的欢迎。

entries.text: Oh, he's wonderful. He leads us. You should talk to him!

entries.text: He preaches peace and enlightenment and all that crap,# but he's scum. No two ways about it.

entries.text: 他总鼓吹和平、启蒙等等的废话。他是个渣滓，无可救药。

entries.text: Ah yes, the Master, he's the god these nuts worship. Personally, I# don't think he's a god, just somebody into manipulating everyone.

entries.text: Oh yeah, these are the guys who've survived torture and who# knows what else. Totally brainwashed and will do# anything they're told.
